start: Member, phone app newer than the watch app, watch connected, on the main tabs, no workout open

steps.action: Open the app and wait a moment
user_sees: 'New on your watch:' with numbered lines (or 'Update it so your watch and phone work well together.')
must_not: The pop-up during a workout
The pop-up while the phone's own update screen is up
The pop-up when the watch is out of reach

user_sees: 'Look at your watch and tap Update there. If its screen is dark, tap it first.'
Buttons 'Got it' and 'Nothing on your watch? Try again'
must_not: Two opens on the watch from a double tap
The pop-up again for this phone version

start: Member, pop-up showing, the watch refuses or does not answer

user_sees: 'Open Play Store on your watch, search for MettleUp and tap Update.'
must_not: A 'Check your watch' line when nothing opened
A crash

user_sees: 'Check that Bluetooth is on, then tap Try again. Or open Play Store on your watch, search for MettleUp and tap Update.'
must_not: A success line

start: Member, a workout is open when the check finds a stale watch app

steps.action: Look at the phone during the workout
must_not: The pop-up over the workout
The pop-up again within 24 hours

steps.action: Open the app after 24 hours, watch still old
must_not: The pop-up never again after one 'Later'

steps.action: Update the watch app, open the phone app
must_not: The pop-up for a watch already up to date

user_sees: Only the version and what is new on the watch
must_not: Workout or health data in the pop-up or sent by the version check
